headlines.description: — The scheduled game between the Milwaukee Brewers and Pittsburgh Pirates was postponed because of rain Friday night and rescheduled for Saturday as part of a day-night doubleheader.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers and Pirates rained out, setting up Saturday doubleheader

headlines.description: — James Outman hit a two-run triple during a five-run sixth inning and the Detroit Tigers won their sixth straight game, 10-2 over the Philadelphia Phillies on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Outman's triple keys five-run inning as Tigers win sixth straight, beating Phillies 10-2

events.name: New York Yankees at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — Jazz Chisholm Jr. hit a two-run homer in the ninth inning to lift the New York Yankees over the Washington Nationals 5-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chisholm's homer keys 3-run 9th as the Yankees rally past Washington 5-3

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Samuel Basallo hit a go-ahead, two-run homer in the eighth inning, and the Baltimore Orioles defeated the Kansas City Royals 5-3 in the opener of a three-game series between last-place teams...
headlines.shortLinkText: Samuel Basallo's 8th-inning homer lifts the Orioles to a 5-3 win over the Royals

headlines.description: — Hunter Greene struck out 12 and allowed three hits in seven dominant innings, Elly De La Cruz and JJ Bleday homered and the Cincinnati Reds beat the Chicago Cubs 4-0 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hunter Greene strikes out 12 and allows 3 hits in 7 innings as Reds defeat Cubs 4-0

headlines.description: — Parker Messick gave up one hit and one run in six strong innings, Chase DeLauter hit a home run, and the Cleveland Guardians beat the Miami Marlins 3-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guardians beat Marlins 3-2 behind Parker Messick’s 6 strong innings

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Junior Caminero hit his 28th homer, one of four longballs for Tampa Bay, and All-Star Nick Martinez pitched effectively into the sixth inning as the Rays beat the Seattle Mariners 7-2 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Junior Caminero hits his 28th homer and Rays go deep 4 times in 7-2 win over Mariners

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Tristan Peters had his first career cycle, Sean Burke pitched seven innings of one-run ball and the Chicago...
headlines.shortLinkText: Peters hits for 1st career cycle, Burke pitches 7 strong innings as White Sox dismantle A's 14-1

events.name: Boston Red Sox at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Sonny Gray shook off travel woes that led to the Red Sox making a late arrival to New York, pitching six strong innings as Boston beat the Mets...
headlines.shortLinkText: Sonny Gray gives Red Sox solid start after travel woes and Boston beats the Mets 6-2

headlines.description: — Wyatt Langford and Jake Burger homered in a four-run eighth inning as the Texas Rangers beat the Houston Astros 7-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Langford and Burger homer in a four-run eighth as the Rangers beat the Astros 7-3

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Vaughn Grissom went 2 for 3 with a home run and two RBI, and the Los Angeles Angels beat the Minnesota Twins 4-3 on Friday night to snap a five-game skid at Target Field.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vaughn Grissom hits HR, Angels beat Twins 4-3 to snap 5-game skid at Target Field

events.name: Atlanta Braves at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Jimmy Crooks homered in the eighth inning and the St. Louis Cardinals beat the Atlanta Braves 2-1 early Saturday in a game that featured a 2-hour, 44-minute rain delay.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals outlast the Braves 2-1 early Saturday after a long rain delay

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Kazuma Okamoto hit his 22nd home run to tie Shohei Ohtani for the most by a Japanese-born rookie in a season in the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Blue Jays' Okamoto hits 22nd homer to tie Ohtani's rookie mark in 5-3 win over Padres

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Eduardo Rodr guez shook off Shohei Ohtani's leadoff homer to throw six solid innings, Tim Tawa homered and drove in four runs and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 9-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Diamondbacks shake off Ohtani's leadoff homer to rout the Dodgers 9-3

events.name: Colorado Rockies at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Kyle Karros hit a broken-bat, two-run single during a three-run ninth inning and the Colorado Rockies held on to beat the San Francisco Giants 4-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Karros' 2-run single in the ninth helps Rockies rally past Giants 4-3
